initial_conditions: Open the two-piece Harbor project at revision 24 with its front already rotated 0.8037662785 radians about World X. Use Front view and 10 mm snap.
actions: Select both Scene rows with Harbor front active. Drag a selected pattern 54 screen points right and 27 points up. Save the project.
Choose Local Z and drag the common dial counterclockwise through approximately one quarter turn. Save, Undo, save, Redo and save.
Toggle front membership in the 2D pattern and back membership in the 3D garment. Start a new empty project and reopen the saved Harbor.
expected_outcomes: Both members translate by [0.2, 0.1, 0] m and rotate about the same fixed world pivot. Undo and Redo restore the complete adjacent documents. Reopening retains both placements and starts with an empty selection.
